items.title: Fred Minor Interview, 1961-11-01
items.q: Well I had an uncle, I still have an uncle, and he was playing drums. His name is Christopher Miner.

ctx.x: Well I had an uncle, I still have an uncle, and he was playing drums.
His name is Christopher Miner. Do you have his address or can you tell me?
At the present time I don't have his address, but he lives on Polgar between Claiborne and Durban. About two doors from Claiborne.
